integrity: The exact-rational finite census supplements an analytic theorem valid for arbitrary candidate counts. The five-voter witness and independent swap-sum derivation are fully displayed.
scientific_limitations: Exact single-swap local PAV for two-seat committees, unweighted finite approval elections. The five-voter classification is for ballot restrictions to four candidates in the dominated committee pair; it does not enumerate outside-candidate approvals. No independent audit or proof assistant certification was undertaken; priority relative to unindexed literature is not established.
title: Five voters are necessary and sufficient for Pareto failure of exact local PAV with two seats
